facts.finding: Python 3.12 or newer and a heavy mandatory dependency graph are required, including WhisperX, pyannote-audio, llama-cpp-python and huggingface-hub.

Alternative backend imports are not fully declared by the package: FunASR uses funasr/tqdm and optional opencc; Breeze uses funasr, torch, transformers and torchaudio; FireRed uses funasr and an external source checkout.
An unresolved model name can flow downstream as a path/name, so backend libraries may attempt their own network model resolution unless MAGI preflights and rejects missing local artifacts.
Unknown asr_backend values fall through to WhisperX instead of being rejected.
ASR and alignment are configured for CPU operation; diarization may select MPS. This is not an MLX Whisper implementation.
The default batch_size_s is 300 and model resolution is delegated to FunASR-compatible paths.
The backend expects an external ~/Projects/FireRedASR2S checkout and globally monkey-patches torch Tensor.cuda and Module.cuda to MPS, creating process-wide compatibility risk.
The backend uses MPS plus FunASR VAD/CAM++ and torchaudio resampling, but those direct dependencies are absent from pyproject.toml.

covered: generic transcript dataclasses and JSON formatting
missing: long-duration Apple Silicon memory and thermal tests

facts.finding: JSON is a direct dataclasses.asdict serialization and has no schema version, backend id, model id or source provenance.
Word timestamps and score availability differ by backend, and no common validation enforces finite monotonic timestamps or duration bounds.
Language identifiers and Traditional Chinese conversion behavior are backend-dependent; OpenCC is optional in relevant paths.
WhisperX uses a batch size of 16 and loads audio for a multi-stage ASR/alignment/diarization pipeline; source alone does not establish its peak unified-memory or accelerator footprint.
FunASR defaults to 300 seconds per batch, explicitly trading more memory for speed.
Breeze and FireRed retain an embedding per VAD segment and perform nested pairwise speaker comparisons, creating O(n^2) comparison work for many segments.
MPS compatibility, Metal footprint, thermal behavior, cleanup after cancellation and long legal recordings are unmeasured at this commit.
